name: PowerLutions Solar
old_description: Anyone can install solar panels. We also serve as your advisor and advocate, designing your ideal PV product, layout, and financing plan.
about:
PowerLutions Solar, operating as PowerLutions LLC, was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Lakewood, New Jersey. The company maintains additional offices in Hackensack, New Jersey; Spring Valley and Brooklyn, New York; and Miami, Florida.

The firm provides full-service solar photovoltaic and battery storage installation for residential and commercial customers across New Jersey, New York, Florida, Connecticut, and Massachusetts. Its process covers site assessment, custom system design, permitting, interconnection, installation, and ongoing monitoring. The company also arranges financing structures, including zero-down loans and lease options, and assists clients with state incentive programs such as New Jersey's Clean Energy Program and SuSI.

PowerLutions serves homeowners, commercial property owners, and industrial facilities. A noted case study describes a New Jersey logistics operator that manufactures custom packing materials; the installer deployed a south-facing rooftop array covering 95 percent of the facility's electricity demand. The company also works with utilities and public entities, referencing Public Service Enterprise Group on Long Island.

The company differentiates itself through a NABCEP-certified leadership team and a one-to-one project management model that assigns a dedicated specialist to each account. Its advisory approach emphasizes maximizing available incentives, transparent pricing, and a guided process from initial consultation through system energization.
